svg.title: Power integrated over the stamp heating duration
svg.desc: Incident power Pin divides into absorbed power in the layer and silicon ink. Multiplying each declared constant power by duration tau gives the corresponding energy ledger.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Power × duration gives an energy ledger
